# Documentation for `scw workflows`
This API is a boilerplate for products.

## 




### Create a new workflow definition in a specified Project

Create a new workflow definition in a specified Project.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw workflows definition create [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                              | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                                                                      |
|-----------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| name                              | Name of the workflow definition                                             | Required<br />Default: `<generated>`                                                         |
| description                       | Description of the workflow                                                 |                                                                                              |
| project-id                        | Project ID to use. If none is passed the default project ID will be used    |                                                                                              |
| environment-variables.{key}       | Environment variables of the workflow                                       |                                                                                              |
| workflow-timeout                  | Timeout of the workflow in seconds                                          |                                                                                              |
| cron-schedule.schedule            |                                                                             |                                                                                              |
| cron-schedule.timezone-identifier |                                                                             |                                                                                              |
| cron-schedule.overlap             |                                                                             | One of: `unknown_schedule_overlap_policy`, `forbid`, `buffer_one`, `buffer_all`, `allow_all` |
| workflow-version.name             |                                                                             |                                                                                              |
| workflow-version.description      |                                                                             |                                                                                              |
| workflow-version.workflow-dsl     |                                                                             |                                                                                              |
| region                            | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par`                                                      |



### Delete an existing workflow definition by its unique identifier

Delete an existing workflow definition by its unique identifier.

**Usage:**

```shell

```


**Arguments:**

| Name                   | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                 |
|------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| workflow-definition-id | UUID of the workflow definition to delete                                   | Required                                |
| region                 | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par` |

### List all your workflow definitions with filters

List all your workflow definitions with filters.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw workflows definition list [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                  | Description                                                                        | Argument Specifications                                                                                                                                  |
|-----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| order-by              |                                                                                    | One of: `created_at_asc`, `created_at_desc`, `name_asc`, `name_desc`, `updated_at_asc`, `updated_at_desc`                                                |
| name                  |                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                          |
| project-id            | Project ID to use. If none is passed the default project ID will be used           |                                                                                                                                                          |
| statuses.{index}      |                                                                                    | One of: `unknown_run_status`, `initialized`, `validated`, `queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `interrupting`, `interrupted`, `pausing`, `paused` |
| created-after         |                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                          |
| created-before        |                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                          |
| trigger-types.{index} |                                                                                    | One of: `unknown_trigger_type`, `manual`, `scheduled`                                                                                                    |
| organization-id       | Organization ID to use. If none is passed the default organization ID will be used |                                                                                                                                                          |
| region                | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config        | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par`, `all`                                                                                                           |



### Run an existing workflow definition using its unique identifier and create a new workflow run

Run an existing workflow definition using its unique identifier and create a new workflow run.

**Usage:**

```shell

```


**Arguments:**

| Name                        | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                 |
|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| workflow-definition-id      | UUID of the workflow definition to start                                    | Required                                |
| environment-variables.{key} | Contextual environment variables for this specific workflow run             |                                         |
| region                      | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par` |

### Update an existing workflow version by its unique identifier

Update an existing workflow version by its unique identifier.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw workflows version update <workflow-version-id ...> [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                | Description                                                                                                   | Argument Specifications                 |
|---------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| workflow-version-id | UUID of the workflow version to update                                                                        | Required                                |
| name                | Name of the workflow version                                                                                  |                                         |
| description         | Description of the workflow version                                                                           |                                         |
| workflow-dsl        | DSL of workflow in YAML format based from https://open-workflow-specification.org/schemas/1.0.3/workflow.yaml |                                         |
| region              | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config                                   | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par` |
